title: kbdecide.py rejects a proposal with invalidate and guards supersede and restore
goal: invalidate accepts a proposed decision as well as an active one, with --reason, and needs no maker for it (check.py accepts an invalidated row with no by or by_ref that was never active); supersede and restore refuse without --by operator, while invalidate stays open to agents for the context sweep; tests named kbdecide_withdraw plant each refusal and the rejected proposal.
